full_judgment: 8. From the consideration of the materials on record as it is seen that the land in suit is fisheries and consequent thereupon on the acquisition of rent receiving interest as per the provision of State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 the fishery has vested in the Government and as such plaintiffs by purchase from the Loke Patni and others who were representing villagers and who had no saleable interest in the land in suit, did not acquire any title.
